title: 第12章
content_zh:
林美娟知道展颜要来，她应该起个疑心，这事儿，是大学好友宋笑提醒的，宋笑这么提醒她，无非是参照自己：明明很漂亮的一人，非要在年轻时跟一个当她爸都嫌大的人在一起，无名无分，生了个女儿，日子就这么过着，女儿随她姓，叫宋如书，跟贺图南同校。
本来，两人交情一般，自从搬到同一小区，宋笑很主动，她毕竟每日无所事事，随时可登门拜访。贺以诚暗示过林美娟，少和宋笑来往，他是男人，一眼看出宋笑这人骚得若即若离，他的妻子，则是个家教良好，本性单纯的女人。
他带展颜回来时，宋笑脱了鞋正窝在他家沙发里咯咯笑，像只愚蠢的母鸡，旁边，坐着尽地主之谊的林美娟，他知道，她是那种心里不耐烦也不会流露半分，总不好叫对方丢面子的人。
除了书包，其他东西都是贺以诚弄进来的，展颜本以为进城要住寄宿学校，当得知要住贺叔叔家里，一下拘谨起来，她有那么一瞬，非常后悔，后悔赌气来了，她应该跟贺叔叔说清楚，自己并不急着来城里。
现在一切都晚了，那么久的路途，风景渐变，直到最后变成完全陌生的模样，恐惧就像细小的火苗，在微微地动。
可她的书包，她背了一路，后背微湿，好像是把整个家乡都给背出来了，又沉又旧。
“颜颜，不用换鞋了，进来。”贺以诚看到展颜面对新拖鞋刹那间的表情，果断放弃，手很自然地搭在她肩头，顺势轻带了一把。
“这是你林阿姨，”他指着林美娟，展颜腼腆抬眼，看到一个面容清秀，很端庄的女人，她冲人鞠躬，“林阿姨好。”
展颜这才看见她，很好看的一个人，是展颜从没见过的，她不知道，女的还能这样，娇滴滴的，甜蜜蜜的，像过来蹭你腿又懒洋洋走开的猫咪。
“宋笑，你看，家里来客人了，我就不留你在这聊了，改天吧。”林美娟站起来，走到展颜身旁，摸摸她的头，“你就是颜颜啊？坐车肯定累了吧，来，坐下吃点水果。”
话说完，展颜还没坐下，宋笑起来了，她一动，满屋子玫瑰香水味道也跟着动，肆虐攻占嗅觉，展颜莫名觉得有些害怕，那种对成熟的，妖娆的，像咬一口汁液就要溅出来的未知世界的害怕。
“贺总真是大善人呀。”宋笑凤眼如丝，白腻的手，蜻蜓点水地拍了下贺以诚的肩膀，她扭着腰，袅袅地走了。
贺以诚本想说点什么，碍于展颜在，只是意味深长看了眼林美娟，做妻子的，意会了，可不知怎的，林美娟倒觉得，她没那么不喜欢宋笑，相反，两人在聊天中，她羡慕宋笑又粗鄙又放肆的那个劲儿。
这里是陌生的，陌生的地板，陌生的窗帘，还有，展颜从没见过的卫生间，林美娟微笑着教她怎么用马桶：
展颜听出话里的那层意思，说：“还让图南哥哥住这儿吧，我住哪儿都行。”
“没事儿，你是女孩子，住这儿更好点儿。”林美娟脸上始终有淡淡笑意，她打量着她，娇嫩的脸，美丽的眼睛，即使留着一头糟糕凌乱的短发，也被人自动忽略。
床上的被褥是新的，书桌上整齐摆放着各类书籍，地板上，则一尘不染，连根头发都没有，展颜从没见过这么干净的房子。
妈也爱收拾，可家里怎么都干净不了，奶奶养的鸡，动不动就溜达到堂屋去了，留一泡热乎乎的屎。
content_en:
Lin Meijuan knew that Zhan Yan was coming, so she should be suspicious. Song Xiao, her friend from college, reminded her about this. Song Xiao reminded her in this way, just for reference: a very beautiful person had to be with a man who was too old for her father when she was young. She had no name and no status, and gave birth to a daughter. She lived like this. The daughter took her surname and was named Song Rushu, who went to the same school as He Tunan.
Originally, the two had a normal friendship, but since they moved to the same community, Song Xiao has been very proactive. After all, she has nothing to do every day and can visit her at any time. He Yicheng had hinted to Lin Meijuan that she seldom interacted with Song Xiao. He was a man, and he could tell at a glance that Song Xiao was so coquettish that he seemed to be away from her, while his wife was a woman with a good upbringing and a simple nature.
When he brought Zhan Yan back, Song Xiao took off her shoes and was giggling like a stupid hen on the sofa in his house. Next to her, Lin Meijuan, who was doing her best to be a landlord, was sitting. He knew that she was the kind of person who would not show even a hint of her impatience, as she would never embarrass the other person.
Except for the schoolbag, everything else was brought in by He Yicheng. Zhanyan thought she would live in a boarding school when she went to the city. When she learned that she would live in Uncle He's house, she became cautious. For a moment, she regretted it very much. She regretted that she was angry. She should have made it clear to Uncle He that she was not in a hurry to come to the city.
It's all too late now. After such a long journey, the scenery gradually changed until it finally turned into a completely unfamiliar look. Fear was like a small flame, moving slightly.
But she carried her schoolbag all the way, and her back was slightly damp, as if she had carried her entire hometown on her back. It was heavy and old.
"Yanyan, there's no need to change your shoes. Come in." He Yicheng saw Zhanyan's expression when she faced the new slippers and gave up decisively. He naturally put his hand on her shoulder and took advantage of the situation.
"This is your Aunt Lin," he pointed at Lin Meijuan, raised his eyes shyly, and saw a pretty and dignified woman. She bowed to her, "Hello, Aunt Lin."
Only then did Zhanyan see her. She was a very good-looking person that Zhanyan had never seen before. She didn't know that a woman could be like this, so delicate and sweet, like a cat that comes to rub your legs and then lazily walks away.
"Song Xiao, look, there are guests at home. I won't leave you chatting here. Let's wait another day." Lin Meijuan stood up, walked to Zhanyan and touched her head, "Are you Yanyan? You must be tired from the car ride. Come on, sit down and eat some fruit."
After saying that, before Zhanyan could sit down, Song started laughing. As soon as she moved, the smell of rose perfume in the room also moved, wreaking havoc on her sense of smell. Zhanyan felt inexplicably a little scared, the kind of fear of the mature, enchanting, unknown world where juice would splash out when she took a bite.
"Mr. He is such a kind person." Song Xiaofeng's eyes were as silk as silk, and her white hands patted He Yicheng's shoulder lightly. She twisted her waist and walked away.
He Yicheng wanted to say something, but due to Zhanyan's presence, he just glanced at Lin Meijuan meaningfully. His wife understood, but somehow Lin Meijuan felt that she didn't dislike Song Xiao that much. On the contrary, when the two of them were chatting, she envied Song Xiao's vulgar and unrestrained energy.
This place is unfamiliar, with unfamiliar floors, unfamiliar curtains, and a bathroom that Zhanyan has never seen before. Lin Meijuan smiled and taught her how to use the toilet:
Zhanyan heard the meaning behind the words and said, "Let Brother Tunan live here. I can live anywhere."
"It's okay, you're a girl, it's better to live here." Lin Meijuan always had a faint smile on her face, and she looked at her. Her delicate face, beautiful eyes, even with a messy short hair, were automatically ignored by others.
The bedding on the bed was new, and various books were neatly placed on the desk. The floor was spotless, with not even a hair on it. Zhanyan had never seen such a clean house.
Mom also likes to clean up, but the house is never clean. Grandma’s chickens often wander into the main room.Go, leave a hot shit behind.
